title: Page Metadata
purpose: Keep the human-visible document and its machine-facing representations consistent across browser identity, search/indexing signals, social sharing, structured data and agent discovery.

learning_contract.false_simplification: A web page is not only what is visible in the browser viewport.
reader_should_understand: document title, search description, social preview, structured data and agent discovery are different representations of the same page
these representations may adapt wording to their context but must not contradict the page
meta keywords are not a useful Google Search ranking/indexing mechanism
robots metadata is not access control
JSON-LD, Build DNA and example JSON solve different problems
llms.txt is an agent-discovery proposal, not a required HTML web standard

source_of_truth.rule: Define page facts once where practical, then deliberately adapt representations for each consumer. Duplication must not create contradictory identity, URLs, descriptions or entities.
page_facts: share image identity and alt text
never_invent: structured-data properties not supported by the visible page

identity_contract.title: The document title identifies the page outside its visible heading context; it need not be byte-identical to the H1.
identity_contract.description: A concise external description. Search engines may choose other page text for snippets.
identity_contract.canonical: A preferred representative URL signal, not access control and not a guarantee that a search engine will select it.

indexing_contract.robots_meta: Declare indexing/result-display preferences only when needed.
indexing_contract.security_boundary: robots meta and robots.txt are crawler/indexing mechanisms, not authorization or secrecy controls.

meta_keywords.rule: Do not add meta keywords for Google Search ranking or indexing. If shown educationally, label them as a historical anti-example.

social_contract.rule: Treat the share card as an intentional external representation, not as an arbitrary image scraped from the page.

structured_data_contract.rule: Structured data must describe entities and facts actually represented by the page; syntactic validity does not guarantee a rich search result.

distinguish_from.JSON-LD: structured semantic representation of published page/entity

agent_discovery_contract.status: llms.txt is a proposal with v2 published August 2026; present it as agent-discovery guidance, not a mandatory web standard.
agent_discovery_contract.rule: Prefer the most specific applicable llms.txt and keep linked machine-readable resources consistent with the human reference.

consistency_contract.review_question: Do all representations tell the same truth about this page?

accessibility.social_image_alt: When og:image is provided, provide meaningful og:image:alt for the image's share-context purpose.
accessibility.inspector: Human teaching UI remains keyboard operable, visible at 320 CSS px and understandable without color alone.

visual.concept: Begin with deliberately sparse visible fine print, then reveal machine perspectives as an inspector.
preserve: contrast between little visible content and rich machine metadata
clear labels for Browser, Search, Social, JSON-LD and Agents

constraints: Do not present meta keywords as a Google Search optimization.
Do not describe noindex or robots.txt as security.
Do not promise that meta description will be used verbatim as a search snippet.
Do not treat canonical as an absolute directive.
Do not invent structured-data facts absent from the page.
Do not describe llms.txt as a required WHATWG, W3C or IETF standard.
Do not collapse JSON-LD, Build DNA and demo JSON into one generic JSON concept.
Do not let social/search/structured representations materially contradict the visible page.

agent_contract.instruction: Reconstruct the metadata concern from this Build DNA. First establish page facts and published URLs, then derive browser, search, social, structured-data and agent representations without inventing facts.
agent_contract.when_conflicting: Factual consistency, source-of-truth rules and constraints override visual resemblance or SEO folklore.
agent_contract.output_expectation: Metadata appropriate to the target page plus an explicit list of unresolved facts/URLs that require owner input.

acceptance: The page has a meaningful document title and description.
Canonical/public URL decisions are explicit and consistent with Open Graph and structured identity.
Robots metadata is never presented as access control.
Open Graph core metadata represents the same page and image alt is provided when an image is declared.
JSON-LD facts match the visible page.
Meta keywords appear only as a clearly labelled anti-example.
Markdown, llms.txt and Build DNA discovery links are present.
The human inspector works without JavaScript for core content and enhances without hiding information.
The reference has no page-level horizontal overflow at 320 CSS px.
The reference has no automatically detectable WCAG A/AA violations.

examples.note: The reference page dogfoods the metadata concern and exposes its own machine-facing layers through the inspector.
